document_data.title: Referral Letter to Cardiology
document_data.content:
Dear Cardiologist,

I am writing to refer Mrs. Evelyn Smith, a 65-year-old female patient with a history of hypertension, for further evaluation and management. During her most recent visit on October 1, 2026, her blood pressure was elevated, and it was noted that there is no recent INR on file for her.

She is currently prescribed lisinopril 10mg daily. Given her condition, I believe a cardiology consultation is warranted to ensure optimal management.

Please let me know if you require any additional information.

Sincerely,
D-01 Rivera
